card.name: Inside UGT and UGDP abbreviations
card.fires_on: The piece 'UG' or 'G' right after 'U' in abbreviations such as UGT (glucuronosyltransferase enzymes) and UGDP (a diabetes study), plus 'Ug' in Ugandan.
